instruction: Use ug-document extract on the file Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov 2-3 v2.pdf to get the billed work: for each date (Nov 2 and Nov 3) the billed start time, end time, total billed hours and the hourly rate if printed, plus the billed amount per day. Return the extracted rows as a list.

Start-time 2026-11-02 00:00, end-time 2026-11-03 23:59, timezone America/New_York, topic HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Ana Ruiz, limit 200.
